findings.title: 185 of 345 injury rows carry a practice status but no injury designation and no game status
findings.evidence: Of those, 140 are recorded as 'Full Participation in Practice'. Clubs with the most such rows: LAC 19, SEA 11, NYG 10. An official injury report normally lists a body part for every player on it, so a block of rows with practice status only is more likely a capture artefact than a real report shape. The file belongs to the requirements session (f6e60a81), so it is flagged here and not edited. This workspace reads the same file, so its per-club row counts inherit whatever shape it has.
